def bbox(fr,col):
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']==col:

            return (min(rows),min(cols),max(rows),max(cols))
def timer(fr):
    return [n for n in fr.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='N'][0]['pixels']
def done():
    return {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in('level_completed','game_over','done')}

print("after 2R (le=36):",done(),"bar",bbox(current_frame,'b'),"t",timer(current_frame))
if not (last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('done')):
    action(['LEFT'])
    print("after 1L (le=32):",done(),"bar",bbox(current_frame,'b'),"t",timer(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
